subject.title: Feature request: configurable announce/connection timeout for gateway

question: Should stalled gateway lifecycle work be governed by new gateway-level timeout config, or split across existing owner-specific timeout surfaces?
rationale: The requested fix adds public config and lifecycle failure semantics across gateway, channel, agent, provider, and plugin owners, and repository policy treats config/default additions as product and compatibility decisions.

options.title: Define One Gateway Lifecycle Policy
options.body: Choose the bounded phases, defaults, logs, fast-failure behavior, and restart integration before accepting implementation work.

options.title: Keep Owner-Specific Timeouts
options.body: Handle announce, channel connection, provider connection, MCP, and plugin startup with narrower existing or new owner-specific knobs.

options.title: Require Live Stall Proof First
options.body: Ask for redacted logs or Crabbox/live proof of the specific stalled phase before deciding which owner should change.

recommendation.title: Define One Gateway Lifecycle Policy
recommendation.body: Choose the bounded phases, defaults, logs, fast-failure behavior, and restart integration before accepting implementation work.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-history connection across sessions_send, gateway schema, and runtime ownership needed for the policy choice.
